titre: Marques de distributeur : le rayon santé résiste
sous_titre: Variation des ventes en %, 52 semaines closes le 15 juin 2025

Produits frais.texte: led by Refrigerated, which was up 13%, followed by Beverages, (+4.8%), Frozen (+3.8%), General Food (+2.5%)

Boissons.texte: followed by Beverages, (+4.8%), Frozen (+3.8%), General Food (+2.5%), Pet Care (+2%)

Surgelés.texte: Beverages, (+4.8%), Frozen (+3.8%), General Food (+2.5%), Pet Care (+2%), Home Care (+1.4%)

Alimentation générale.texte: Frozen (+3.8%), General Food (+2.5%), Pet Care (+2%), Home Care (+1.4%), and Beauty (+1.1%)

Beauté.texte: Pet Care (+2%), Home Care (+1.4%), and Beauty (+1.1%)

Santé.texte: General Merchandise (-0.4%) and Health (-0.1%) were down.
